content_html:
watched #UmaMaheswaraUgraRoopasya : when an extraordinary director Maha, sensible producer Praveena (both c/o Kancherlapalem fame) associated with very talented Satya for a malayalam remake, i was confused why they were wasting their talent and man I got my answer _/\_

to start with, I havent watched the original version but can confirm that only malayalam makers can only come up with such simple yet impactful subjects _/\_ Direction, Camera, Locations, Dialogues, Song Lyrics, Acting & BGM have been a top notch!!! Songs and Pace of the movie are the only negatives I can think about

Satya has completely nailed it with his subtle yet impactful performance and has been well suported by each and every artist in the movie.

I was completely blown away with the whole chain of incidents which lead to the major plot of the movie. How in the worlc can one come up with such a simple events which lead to the butterfly effect.

A MUST WATCH…..
